name: babynews
description: Read-only access to BabyNews (ibabynews.com), Korea's pregnancy, birth and parenting news outlet: articles, curated Q&A and regional childbirth support programs.

interface.longDescription:
Read-only connector to BabyNews (ibabynews.com), a Korean news outlet specializing in pregnancy, childbirth and parenting since 2010. Search articles with hybrid semantic and keyword search, read an article (first 2,000 characters plus the original URL), browse the latest and category articles, find related articles, search curated Q&A (parenting, wedding, pets, insurance, law, labor) built on official sources, and look up regional childbirth and parenting support programs by city and district in Korea. Results include the article title, publication date and original URL so answers can cite BabyNews. Medical information is for reference only. No account is needed.

임신·출산·육아 전문 언론 베이비뉴스. 기사, 전문가 육아 Q&A, 지역별 출산·육아 지원사업을 찾아 줍니다.
defaultPrompt: 베이비뉴스 기사로 임신 20주 정밀초음파 시기 알려줘

positive.prompt: 베이비뉴스 기사로 임신 20주 정밀초음파는 언제 하는지 알려줘
positive.expected_behavior: Returns BabyNews articles with title, publication date and original URL; the answer cites them.
Returns central, Seoul and Mapo-gu childbirth support programs with how to apply and Bokjiro links.
Returns Q&A items with a direct answer and official source names and URLs.

positive.prompt: 이유식 언제 시작해? 베이비뉴스 정보로 알려줘
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Q&A and articles together, each with source and date.

positive.prompt: 베이비뉴스 임신·출산 분야 최신 기사 3개와 첫 기사의 관련 기사 보여줘
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 3 recent pregnancy/birth articles and related articles, each with URL.

negative.description: Weather questions should not trigger BabyNews tools
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Seoul tomorrow?

negative.description: Plain translation should not trigger BabyNews tools
negative.prompt: Translate this sentence into English: 오늘 날씨가 좋다

negative.description: Booking requests should not trigger BabyNews tools (read-only, cannot book)
negative.prompt: Book me a pediatrician appointment for tomorrow

publication.release_notes: v1.0.0 First public release. 12 read-only tools over BabyNews articles, curated Q&A and regional childbirth support programs in Korea. No authentication. Public access returns the first 2,000 characters of an article plus the original URL. No sponsored content.
